name: Gen 3 Dex
description: The Pokedex as a grid of pictures instead of a list of names. Owned species wear their own palette -- twenty-one colours at once where the Game Boy could show four -- seen-but-uncaught are dimmed, and the rest are blanks. SELECT filters to OWNED, MISSING or SEEN ONLY. A offers DATA / CRY / AREA like the vanilla list -- AREA is the engine's own nest map, which blinks every place the species lives. DATA goes to the engine's own species page, so Useful Dex's extra pages still work.
